title: Sunday Worship Service
description: Our weekly gathering for worship, the breaking of bread and the ministry of the Word. Families and visitors are warmly welcome; Zaboor & Geet books are provided at the door.

title: Wednesday Bible Study
description: A verse-by-verse study through the book of Romans, with time for questions and discussion. Bring your Urdu Study Bible; printed outlines are available for those who need them.

title: Youth Fellowship
description: An afternoon for young brothers and sisters — singing, a short message on walking with the Lord, refreshments and games. Parents are welcome to stay.

title: Monthly Fasting & Prayer
description: A day set apart for fasting and united prayer for the church in Pakistan, for the persecuted, and for the spread of the gospel. Lunch is served at the close of the meeting.

title: Sunday School Teachers' Training
description: Equipping for brothers and sisters teaching children's classes: lesson preparation, memory verses and handling questions with gentleness. Workbooks are distributed at the end.
